body: @sorin-costea I think it's a valid issue. Can you create your reproducer?

I just noticed that after switching to using only commons-logging-jboss-logging, unit testing doesn't work anymore. ES wants for some reason a wrong LogManager, which it cannot find (no log4j dependencies in sight)... I guess I'll have to stop fiddling with native generation for a while :(

If you can provide a reproducer for the second issue, I can have a look too.

Are you sure you didn't exclude the JBoss Logging Log4j 2 adapter?
